## Addendum · from the #29390 contract review (PR #29632, record on the PR) · 2026-11-02T23:01Z

Two items from the review land on this card, because it is the next card in the same serial chain (#29390 → this card → #29397 → #29479) and touches the same restore limb.

1. **The restore limb's package-less sibling (review S2, pre-existing on main).** Take an `apply` commit whose item edited a row bound to a read-only base, then delete that row with the open delete naming the base. A revert of the commit then finds no active row: `resolveOverlayPackageBinding` answers `null`, neither close is asked, and `SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` INSERTS an unbound row with the pre-commit body (its null-binding default). That is the package-less write #28576 closes. `rollbackMetaItemUnaudited` refuses the same restore on the same `null` binding through `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`. Wanted here: the commit revert's restore limb asks the package-less close on a `null` binding exactly as the per-item rollback does (one predicate, the rollback arm, no second spelling), with a red-first case on the deleted-row path and a control for a writable package's row.
2. **The `packageless-overlay-write-closed` entry does not name the commit doors (review S1, text only).** Since #29535 the entry in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts` names both meta-door addresses (package-less and naming the read-only package). It does not yet name the commit doors (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert`, `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/rollback`) as a further address of the same close, which #29632 makes real. Widen the entry's surface and reason text to name them here, as a seat-agreed surface amendment (the spec lane is winding down). It is text only: no new id, no new key.

Both widen this card's scope. The seat amends the claim when it dispatches this card.
